selection_rule.order: Preserved known.json dataset row order; no sorting by attractive output
selection_rule.primary: First row for which all three reader arms route every emitted-token query to the target fact, and block_outer predicts the edited word correctly at its position in exactly three normalized words but has full EM=0.
selection_rule.secondary: First row satisfying the same primary predicate and edited_word_index=2. Null means no qualifying third-word example.
selection_rule.unfiltered_third_word: Separately provided first dataset row with edited_word_index=2, regardless of routing/correctness. This is explicitly not a qualifying primary case.

definitions.all_route_target: Every saved query aligned with an emitted token selects flattened target slots [3*i,3*i+1,3*i+2]. Includes first-output prefill query, subsequent decode queries and terminal EOS query when emitted; no terminal token is removed.
definitions.full_em: NFKC+casefold+Unicode-punctuation-to-space+whitespace normalization, exact full normalized string match.
definitions.edited_word_correct: Exactly three normalized output words and the word at provenance.edited_word_index equals the corresponding target word.
definitions.terminal_token_ids: Recorded without removal; terminal ID histogram is reported. Source generate retains EOS IDs although rendered prediction skips special tokens.
definitions.routing_scope: Recorded routing and raw token alignment verified here; this report does not independently rerun backbone queries or full CPU search. That is covered separately by artifact audit.

limitations: Post-hoc descriptive evidence; never used for checkpoint, hyperparameter, data or arm selection.
Cases share underlying facts across seeds/readers; 48 fact-model cases are not 48 independent facts.

All-query target retrieval does not prove every value direction influences the output or establish a unique readout cause; upstream contextual encoding, residual interaction, frozen backbone and shared learned parameters remain possible factors.

Grouped retrieval includes all three slots, but uniform membership is not the signed operator coefficient or causal contribution. Generated subword token steps are not equated with three word positions.
Traces follow each arm’s own generated prefix; their later queries are not evaluated under a common counterfactual prefix.
The known canonical A/B bindings have different supervised exposure under static and rebind, already reported in operator_diagnostics.json.
